rationale: TopKGate.forward rebinds self.wg to a fresh fp32 Linear under ZeRO+fp16/bf16, orphaning the ZeRO-tracked parameter so its grads are never reduced or applied. Detection requires hooking TopKGate and checking wg.weight identity/data_ptr stays in ZeRO's tracked set across forwards under precond module_class==TopKGate AND ZeRO+mixed-precision (pi_precond). P7 (module-state counter/identity check) over P4 because the check is param-identity not dtype, and the orphan is in DP not EP routing path.
